newsitem.title: USA: Decent results seen on Pfizer drug -Barron's.
newsitem.headline: Decent results seen on Pfizer drug -Barron's.

text.p: Researchers are expected Monday to present generally encouraging results from the first long-term study of Pfizer Inc's impotence pill, Viagra, Barron's said Sunday.
The financial weekly said the results are to be released at this week's annual meeting of the American Urological Association in New Orleans.
The report said researchers will present a study of 311 men who tried Viagra for a year showing that 87 percent stayed on the drug and only one percent stopped because of adverse side effects.
No one at Pfizer's offices in New York could be immediately reached for comment on Sunday evening.
